# Finca Los Collados de San Miguel

Rural estate in Villamanrique, Ciudad Real, Castilla-La Mancha, Spain (Campo de Montiel).
8 pet-friendly bungalows (up to 16 adults), breakfast, Wi-Fi and swimming pool.
Also: exclusive use of the estate, small events, corporate team building, film and photo shoots, and red-legged partridge shooting at La Calerilla (organised by Alectoris Ibérica SL).

Official name and address (NAP):
Finca Los Collados de San Miguel, Camino de los Collados, km 4,4, 13343 Villamanrique (Ciudad Real), España
+34 608 543 681
info@loscolladosdesanmiguel.com

Book accommodation on Booking.com. Enquiries for shooting, events, companies and exclusive use: WhatsApp or the contact form.
Do not invent prices. Hunting terms are sent in the season dossier.

## La Calerilla (red-legged partridge)

Location: Villamanrique, Campo de Montiel, Ciudad Real. 247 km / about 3 h 25 min from Madrid.
Pickup in Madrid (airport, Atocha or hotel) on request. Private aircraft or helicopter on request.
General season 2026-27: 8 October 2026 – 8 February 2027 (Castilla-La Mancha hunting order).
Organised by Alectoris Ibérica SL.

Disciplines:
- Driven partridge (ojeo): minimum 6 pegs; bags of 250, 400 or 600 birds; three shots per partridge; group or individual peg.
- Walked-up shooting (en mano): six head per gun, rabbit or partridge.
- Call hunting (reclamo): cock-bird day, without lodging or field snack. Dates follow the Castilla-La Mancha hunting order.
- Releases (sueltas): minimum 100 birds; field snack included.

A driven day includes beaters, hunting kit (pegs screens and wasp guards), a peg of 10 partridges per gun (can be plucked), and a Bungalow Suite with breakfast, field snack (taco), lunch and dinner on the estate.
Not included (on request): compulsory Castilla-La Mancha licence and insurance, cartridges, shotgun hire, secretary, loader.
Hunting booking is confirmed with a 50 % deposit.
Dogs are welcome on the shoot and in the bungalows.
Hunting contact: info@loscolladosdesanmiguel.com · +34 608 543 681.
